name: 违法解除赔偿金计算器

map.用人单位违法解除或终止劳动合同，按经济补偿标准的二倍支付赔偿金: Where an employer unlawfully terminates a labor contract, damages of twice the economic compensation standard are payable
map.📖 查看「违法解除赔偿金计算器（2N） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Unlawful Termination Damages Calculator (2N) User Guide"
map.• 不符合法定条件和程序解除劳动合同: • Terminating without the statutory conditions or procedure
map.• 无理由辞退、辞退理由不成立: • Dismissal without reason, or on reasons that do not stand up
map.• 未经法定程序（如未通知工会）裁员: • Redundancy without the statutory procedure, such as not notifying the trade union
map.• 解除\"三期\"女职工、工伤职工、医疗期员工等特殊保护群体: • Terminating specially protected groups such as women in the three protected periods, employees with work injuries, or employees in their medical treatment period
map.• 试用期无理由辞退（需证明不符合录用条件）: • Dismissal during probation without reason, since failure to meet the recruitment conditions must be proved
map.• 劳动合同到期但符合签订无固定期限条件却终止: • Ending the contract on expiry although the conditions for an open-ended contract were met
map.用人单位违法解除/终止劳动合同，劳动者不要求继续履行的，测算 2N 赔偿金。: Where an employer unlawfully terminates a labor contract and the employee does not seek reinstatement, work out the 2N damages.
map.N 按工作年限确定，高薪者基数与年限双封顶。: N follows the years of service, and for high earners both the base and the years are capped.
map.提示 2N 已含经济补偿部分，不另行支付 N。: Note that 2N already includes the compensation element, so N is not paid on top.
map.工作 15 年、基数封顶社平 3 倍（3.5 万）、年限封顶 12：赔偿金 =: 15 years of service, with the base capped at three times the local average wage, that is ¥35,000, and the years capped at 12: damages = 35000 × 12 × 2 = ¥840,000.
map.2N 和 N+1 能同时要吗？: Can 2N and N+1 both be claimed?
map.不能。违法解除适用 2N；合法无过失辞退未提前通知才适用 N+1，二者择一。: No. 2N applies to unlawful termination, while N+1 applies to a lawful no-fault dismissal without notice; you choose one.
map.劳动者可选择要求继续履行合同，或选择不继续履行而主张 2N 赔偿金；具体看职位可: The employee may ask for the contract to continue, or decline that and claim 2N damages instead, depending on how replaceable the post is and on personal preference.
map.违法解除赔偿金计算器。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Unlawful Termination Damages Calculator. A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
